title: lsed: Prevalence-Corrected Evaluation of Species-Distribution Predictions
description: An R (and Python) package for landscape-ecology decisions. It provides prevalence-corrected evaluation of species-distribution model predictions (decision-curve analysis, prevalence-invariant ROC-AUC, average precision, net benefit and Cox calibration) and a site-prioritisation toolkit that combines geographic, resistance, accessibility, complementarity and survey-intensity terms into a RankIndex.
